messages:
michelle: Morning team — kicking off the NewLeaf onboarding. @mark from NewLeaf is here. Our goals: full prod readiness by 6 weeks, success metric: 95% of API calls <200ms, enablement + acceptance by week 4.
mark: Thanks Michelle. Priority is privacy + ability to run in VPC, legal is already looped in on retention policy. We want a staging cutover in week 4.
raj: I'll own the integration checklist and sample app work. Need Mark's current traffic patterns + sample payloads to size pipelines.
mark: Sending traffic samples and schema now: https://files.newleaf.io/openapi.json — will email creds to raj@redwood.
michelle: Great. Can we confirm internal stakeholders? From NewLeaf: @mark (PM), @sjohnson (SRE). Anyone else?
mark: @sjohnson will join next meeting. Also adding @linda (QA) for acceptance testing and @trey (security) for the data flow review.
nana: Quick infra note: for VPC/private deployment we need subnet ranges and peering CR by day 7. I'll drop a peering template in this thread.
nana: Template pasted below:
---
VPC peer request:
- cidr: x.x.x.x/24
- allowed ports: 443, 22
- contact: onboarding@newleaf.com
---
raj: High-level timeline suggestion:
- Week 0–1: infra provisioning + creds + legal kickoff
- Week 2: integration + demo (app -> Redwood API)
- Week 3: validation, perf tuning, acceptance tests
- Week 4: staging cutover + smoke tests
- Week 5: rollback runbook + docs, enablement recordings
- Week 6: prod deploy & 7-day hypercare
michelle: I'll schedule recurring standups Tue/Thu 30m. First standup tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: blockers, risks, actions.
mark: 10:00am PT works. Can we get an enablement session for our product team in week 2? Prefer async recording + a live Q&A.
raj: Yep — I'll host the demo and record. Need specific prompts or sample queries to validate search + embeddings flows.
mark: Primary use-cases: chat completions for customer support triage, embeddings for semantic search. Also want throughput test at ~100 rps during peak hours.
nana: For sustained 100 rps we should evaluate Dedicated capacity or reserved burst. I'll propose a config with bin-packing for tokens and KV cache.
onboarding-bot: Meeting created: "NewLeaf Onboard Standup" — 2024-05-15 17:00 UTC — link: https://cal.meet/newleaf/onboard
michelle: Risk callouts: legal review may take up to 2 weeks; schema changes from NewLeaf could push the integration milestone. Mitigations: parallelize infra + creds and schedule weekly legal check-ins.
mark: Understood. We'll expedite legal and have Linda help triage test cases to avoid rework.
michelle: Action items (initial): Raj — integration checklist + sample app (due day 3); Ana — VPC template + peering CR (due day 5); Mark — traffic samples + full stakeholder list (sent); Michelle — calendar + enablement plan + recording logistics.
raj: Noted, will post the checklist in #customer-success by EOD tomorrow.
michelle: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. See you at the first standup. :slightly_smiling_face:
